podcast.body: This is one of the Beastie Boys' earliest recordings, dating from late 1982, featuring John Berry on guitar and Kate Shellenbach on drums, before Adam Horowitz joined. It is notable as one of the few songs from their hardcore era that remained part of the band's career. "The song is called A Grade on Mojo, and it's one of their earliest recordings."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song is one of the Beastie Boys' earliest recordings from their hardcore era, featured on the *Pollywog Stew* LP. It is one of the few tracks from that period that survived throughout the band's career. "The song is called A Grade on Mojo, and it's one of their earliest recordings, and it's also one of the few songs from their hardcore era that survived throughout the rest of the band's career."
